title: This is a codestyle rule, it does not indicate a possible bug.
summary: Psalm reports it only at error level 1, the strictest level.

title: Uninitialized properties are hard to statically analyze.
summary: To prevent mistakes, Psalm will enforce that all properties should be initialized. Psalm ignores it at error level 5 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when changing the type of a pass-by-reference variable.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 3 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a reference assigned in a potentially confusing scope is reused later.
summary: Since PHP doesn't scope loops and ifs the same way most other languages do, a common issue is the reuse of a variable declared in such a scope. Usually it doesn't matter, because a reassignment to an already-defined variable will just reassign it, but if the already-defined variable is a reference it will change the value of the referred to variable. Psalm ignores it at error level 5 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when using a reserved word as a class name.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 8.
